description: Variation of condition 2 to amend approved balconies fronting Bath Road to provide winter gardens following planning permission APP/F5540/W/16/3162072 dated 22/02/2017 for redevelopment to provide mixed use development including flexible commercial space (Uses A1, A2, A3, A5 and B1) and nine dwellings (Use C3) comprising one one-bedroom, five two-bedroom and three three-bedroom flats, recycle storage, car parking, new boundary, landscaping, amenity space and other associated works
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: LN2924, dated May 2015, received 22/06/2015; 15002/TP/011, dated 04.06.15, received 22/06/2015; 15002/TP/010, dated 04.06.15, received 22/06/2015; Sustainability and Energy Statement, dated June 2015, received 22/06/2015; Environmental Noise Survey and Site Suitability Assessment, dated 10/06/2015, received 22/06/2015; Phase One Desktop Report (Preliminary Risk Assessment), dated March 2014, received 22/06/2015; Groundwater Monitoring Report, dated 5th December 2015, received 22/06/2015; 15002/TP/001, dated 04.06.15, received 22/06/2015; 15002/SK/012, dated 04.06.15, received 22/06/2015; 15002/SK/013, dated 04.06.15, received 22/06/2015; Design & Access Statement, dated June 2015, received 03/07/2015; BRUKL Output Document, dated Apr 29 2015, received 29/07/2015; Energy and Sustainability Addendum, dated July 2015, received 29/07/2015; Geo-Environmental Investigation Report, dated September 2014, received 29/07/2015; Cycle rack specifications, undated, received 11/08/2015; 15002/SK/009 Rev A, dated 16.12.15, received 16/12/2015; Daylight and Sunlight Report, dated 22nd Dec 2015, received 22/12/2015; 15002/TP/003 Rev D, dated 18.01.2016, received 28/01/2016; 10700.SECTION, dated 28.01.2016, received 04/02/2016; JC/AM/10700, dated 29 February 2016, received 07/03/2016
106; 107; 108. Received 04/07/2019. 103B, 104B, 105B. Received 26/11/2019

Condition : 3 - No development using relevant materials shall commence until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the building hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved samples.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed on the building.

Condition : 5 - The A1 and A2 uses hereby permitted shall only take place between the following hours:
0700 - 2300 Monday - Saturday
0800 - 2200 Sundays and Public Holidays

Condition : 6 - The A3 and A5 uses hereby permitted shall only take place between the following hours:
0700 - 2300 Monday - Friday
0700 - Midnight Saturday
0800 - 2300 Sundays and Public Holidays
Condition : 7 - Deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site only between 0800 - 2200 on Mondays to Saturdays and not at any time on Sundays or on Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 8 - Demolition or construction works shall take place only between 0800 -1800 on Mondays to Fridays, 0900 - 1300 on Saturdays and shall not take place at any time on Sundays or on Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved residential units, equipment to control the emission of fumes and odour from the premises, including details of sound attenuation, shall be installed in accordance with a scheme to be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. All equipment installed as part of the approved scheme shall thereafter be operated and maintained in accordance with that approval and retained for so long as the use continues.

Condition : 10 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the submitted drawings shall be constructed and available for use prior to the first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development vehicular access and a loading bay shall be provided in accordance with a scheme to be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved scheme shall thereafter be made available for its intended purpose.

Condition : 13 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development a Delivery and Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
